meta_description: DMW Electrical Services in Leeds. Domestic and commercial electrical work, rewires, testing and repairs. Call 07768 110632 for a free quote today.
hero_eyebrow: Part P Certified — Emergency Call-Outs Available
hero_subhead: Faulty wiring, blown circuits, or a full rewire needed? We fix it fast and give you peace of mind with every job guaranteed.
services_subhead: From emergency repairs to full rewires, we handle domestic and commercial electrical work with speed and precision.

services.title: Emergency Electrical Repairs
services.desc: Blown circuits, flickering lights, or dead sockets? We're on standby 24/7 and aim to reach you fast. Most faults diagnosed and fixed same day.

services.title: Full House Rewires
services.desc: Older property with dodgy wiring? We'll replace the lot to modern safety standards, tested and certified. Typically completed in 3–5 days.

services.title: Consumer Unit Upgrades
services.desc: Old fuse box slowing you down? We'll install a modern consumer unit with RCD protection, giving you safer power distribution and added circuits where you need them.

services.title: Testing & Certification
services.desc: Five-yearly electrical condition reports (EICR) for landlords and businesses. We test, report any faults, and help you stay compliant and safe.

services.title: New Installations
services.desc: Adding an EV charger, kitchen lighting, or outdoor sockets? We design the circuit, install it to Building Regs, and test everything before we leave.

services.title: Commercial Electrical Work
services.desc: Offices, shops, and small businesses need reliable power. We handle rewires, fault-finding, and planned maintenance with minimal disruption to your day.

about_pullquote: We started this because we got tired of seeing customers ripped off by cowboys with no backup.
about_para_1: DMW Electrical Services was founded in 2010 by Dave and Mark, two time-served electricians fed up with the lack of honest traders in Leeds. Over 15 years we've built a reputation for turning up on time, diagnosing faults properly, and charging fair prices with no hidden fees. Every member of the team is Part P certified and insured.
about_para_2: We specialise in emergency call-outs because we know a dead circuit is a nightmare, especially after hours. But we also do the bigger jobs — full rewires, consumer unit upgrades, and commercial installations. Our customers come back because we listen, explain what's wrong in plain English, and do the job right first time.
reviews_heading: What Leeds Homeowners Say About DMW Electrical

reviews.text: Emergency call at 11 pm on a Friday — electrics completely dead in the kitchen. Dave was here by midnight, found a dodgy socket causing the trip, replaced it and had everything working within an hour. Charged a very fair call-out fee. Brilliant service.
reviews.author: Tom B.

reviews.text: Had my whole house rewired by DMW. Professional, tidy, and they explained everything as they went. Took 4 days and they even made the tea! No rushing, no mess left behind. Would absolutely recommend.
reviews.author: Linda H.

reviews.text: Needed an urgent consumer unit replacement. Got a call-out the same day, Dave assessed it properly and gave me a sensible quote. No pressure, no upsell. Job done next morning. This is the kind of electrician you want — honest and quick.
reviews.author: Paul M.
